text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — the guide's checklist and testing details are still missing**

New: Two small pushes (net +1 line), and a comment saying tests and linting pass. The fixture tests were already in the PR when it was first looked at. Missing: The self-review checklist still has the AI-use-policy box and the manual-testing boxes unchecked, and the description doesn't say how the change was tested by hand. It also doesn't mention #39598, an open PR in maintainer review for the same issue.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have the author finish the checklist and testing notes before anyone is assigned.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please go through the [reviewable PRs guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) again: complete the self-review checklist (including the AI use policy item), describe how you tested this by hand, and note how it relates to #39598, which is already in review for the same issue.
```
